name: Grilled rattan shoot
summary: A bitter rattan shoot from deep forest, grilled and dipped in salt pounded with a lot of xiêm chili. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls đọt mây an Êđê specialty, grilled and dipped in chili salt.
howToEat: The article says the best shoots take a long walk into deep forest, and that they are bitter and fragrant. The dip is salt pounded with a lot of xiêm chili, itself bitter and hot. A cook in Ea Tam ward, quoted that day, says Êđê cooks use the shoot against alcohol, bloating, and a swollen stomach. A grill time and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Ea Tam ward is where that cook was quoted. A stall was not named. Where to order it is Check on arrival.
